title: Power Trusted Workspace
description: A trusted data space sample for power operations that combines topology, FSU telemetry, model registry assets, and runbook-guided knowledge into one governed workspace.

scenario.title: Power Device Health and Backup-Time Workspace
scenario.operational_story: The workspace exposes a single device chain with live telemetry, alarm evidence, source provenance, and model registry entries for anomaly detection, load forecasting, and backup-duration estimation.
scenario.governance_story: Data assets, knowledge assets, and model assets are packaged together so agents can trace source, version, and usage before acting.
scenario.analysis_flow: Start from the station, traverse to the device, inspect telemetry and events, then consult the runbook and attached model registry before recommending action.
